security_audit.summary: Most static detections are false positives from Markdown code fences, reference links, and anti-pattern headings. remediation.suggestion: Normalize the output path, keep writes inside the workspace, and require confirmation before overwriting existing files.

remediation.issue: Broad setup and deployment command examples in documentation.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit user confirmation guidance before package installation, Docker, or Kubernetes commands are run.

content.value_statement: Architecture decisions are hard to compare across web, mobile, backend, and cloud systems. This skill provides structured guides and local scaffold scripts for reports, dependency review, and trade-off documentation.
actual_capabilities: Explains architecture patterns, system design workflows, and technology decision criteria from reference guides.
Provides scaffolded Python entry points for architecture reports, project review, and dependency analysis.
Can print a basic local report with target path, status, and finding count.
Can write script results as formatted JSON when the user supplies an output path.
Lists common stack areas for frontend, backend, mobile, database, DevOps, and cloud planning.
limitations: The bundled scripts are scaffolds and do not perform deep static analysis.
The architecture diagram script does not generate visual diagrams by itself.
It does not connect to cloud providers or live infrastructure by itself.
Architecture recommendations still need stakeholder review, threat modeling, and production validation.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Product Architecture
use_cases.description: Create a structured architecture outline across frontend, backend, database, cloud, and DevOps concerns.

use_cases.title: Compare Technology Choices
use_cases.description: Evaluate candidate stacks with clear benefits, trade-offs, security concerns, and scalability limits.

use_cases.title: Review an Existing Project
use_cases.description: Run local scaffold scripts and convert findings into a concise architecture review checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Architecture Overview
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new application.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to outline a system architecture for my application. Cover frontend, backend, data storage, integrations, security, and deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Stack Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare three technology stack options for this product. Explain benefits, trade-offs, operational needs, risks, and when each option fits best.

prompt_templates.title: Review Project Structure
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of an existing repository.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this project architecture using the skill references. Identify boundaries, dependencies, missing documentation, scalability risks, and practical next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Migration Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a phased migration plan for this system. Include target architecture, transition steps, risk controls, rollback criteria, and decision records.

output_examples.input: Review a Next.js and Node.js project before a rewrite.
output: Architecture summary covering frontend, API, data, and deployment boundaries.
Trade-off notes for modular monolith and service split options.
Priority recommendations for documentation, testing, security, and performance checks.

output_examples.input: Choose a stack for a mobile app with realtime collaboration.
output: Technology comparison across mobile framework, API style, database, and hosting choices.
Risk notes for offline sync, authentication, push notifications, and scaling.
Recommended decision path with assumptions that need validation.

output_examples.input: Generate a local architecture report for an existing project.
output_examples.output: A concise report with target path, status, finding count, and review notes for follow-up planning.

best_practices: Share product goals, constraints, team skills, and expected scale before asking for architecture guidance.
Ask for explicit trade-offs and decision records when comparing stack options.
Review script output before using it in documentation or implementation plans.
anti_patterns: Do not treat scaffold script output as a complete architecture assessment.
Do not run install, Docker, or Kubernetes commands without user approval and environment review.
Do not choose a technology stack without validating security, cost, operations, and team fit.

faq.question: Does this skill create production-ready architecture diagrams?
faq.answer: No. The diagram script is a scaffold and produces a basic report, not a finished visual diagram.

faq.question: Can this skill analyze any repository automatically?
faq.answer: It can run scaffold scripts against a target path, but deep code analysis still needs additional tools and human review.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Will it modify my project files?
faq.answer: The scripts can write a report only when an output path is supplied. Review the path before running them.

faq.question: Is it useful for technology selection?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides prompts and references for comparing stack choices, trade-offs, scalability, and security considerations.

faq.question: Should I use its commands without review?
faq.answer: No. Confirm package installation, Docker, Kubernetes, and file-writing commands before execution.
